playlist.nom_requis: Enter a name for the playlist.
partage.lecture_bloquee: Your browser blocked autoplay: press Play to listen.

lecteur.erreur_reseau: This track cannot be played because the connection was lost.
admin.intro: Sign in with a GitHub fine-grained token limited to this repository (permission: Contents, read and write). The token stays in your browser and is only sent to GitHub.
admin.rester: Stay signed in on this device
admin.droit_ok: Write access to the repository confirmed.
admin.erreur.jeton: The token is invalid or has expired.
admin.erreur.droit: This token cannot write to the repository. Grant the permission Contents: read and write.
admin.erreur.introuvable: Repository not found. Check that the token covers it.
admin.erreur.conflit: The repository changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
admin.erreur.limite: GitHub rate limit reached. Try again later.
admin.erreur.reseau: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
admin.erreur.taille: A file exceeds the 100 MB limit of GitHub.
admin.nav.label: Administration sections
admin.liste.tronque: The repository is too large to be listed completely: some tracks may be missing.
admin.nouvelle.glisser: Drop an MP3 file on this area or choose one above. The tags found in the file fill the empty fields.
admin.nouvelle.publier: Publish immediately (otherwise saved as a draft)
admin.nouvelle.ok_publie: Track published. The site updates in a minute or two.
admin.nouvelle.ok_brouillon: Draft saved. The track stays hidden until you publish it.
admin.nouvelle.tags_lus: Fields filled from the file tags.
admin.nouvelle.err_mp3: This file is not an MP3 file.
admin.nouvelle.err_categorie: Choose a category or name a new one.
admin.nouvelle.err_date: The date must be YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.
admin.nouvelle.err_doublon: A track with the identifier {id} already exists. Change the title.
admin.erreur.limite_delai: GitHub rate limit reached. Try again in {minutes} min.
admin.erreur.fiche: A JSON sheet of the repository cannot be read. Fix it on GitHub first.
admin.edition.ok: Changes saved. The site updates in a minute or two.
admin.edition.err_album: A track of an album cannot change category on its own.
admin.edition.err_deplacement: The sheet of this track points to an image shared with other files: it cannot be moved automatically.
admin.edition.album_note: This track belongs to an album: its category follows the album.
admin.groupe.rien: Nothing to change: the selected tracks are already up to date.
admin.groupe.err_refus: Some tracks cannot be processed: {titres}. Nothing was changed.
admin.groupe.ok: Changes saved for {n} tracks. The site updates in a minute or two.
admin.suppression.message: Delete “{titre}” with its sheet and cover? It can no longer be played on the site (the history on GitHub keeps a copy).
admin.suppression.message_lot: Delete {n} tracks with their sheets and covers? They can no longer be played on the site (the history on GitHub keeps a copy).
admin.suppression.album: Tracks that belong to an album are not deleted here.
admin.suppression.ok: Deleted. The site updates in a minute or two.
admin.albums.supprimer_choix: What should happen to its tracks?
admin.albums.supprimer_conserver: Keep them as single tracks of the category
admin.albums.supprimer_ok: Album deleted. The site updates in a minute or two.
admin.album.glisser: Drop several MP3 files here, or choose them above. Their tags fill the track titles and the empty album fields.
admin.album.retrait_note: Tracks removed from an existing album become single tracks of its category.
admin.album.ok_publie: Album published. The site updates in a minute or two.
admin.album.ok_brouillon: Draft saved. The album stays hidden until you publish it.
admin.album.reprise_info: The upload was interrupted after {i} of {total} commits. The form is locked: resume to send the rest.
admin.album.cover_id3: Cover taken from the tags of {nom}.
admin.album.err_disque: Disc numbers must be 1 or more.
admin.album.err_pochette: A published album needs a cover image.
admin.album.err_retrait: The track “{id}” cannot become a single track: that name is already used in the category.
admin.album.err_deplacement: The sheet of a published track points to an image shared with other files: it cannot be moved into the album.
admin.album.err_doublon: An album or files already exist at this place: {id}. Change the title or the category.
admin.cat.ordre_ok: Order saved. The site updates in a minute or two.
admin.cat.ordre_note: The order applies to the home page, the category list and the navigation bar.
admin.cat.ok_creee: Category created. The site updates in a minute or two.
admin.cat.supprimer_contenu: The category “{nom}” contains {n} files (tracks, albums, sheets). Choose where to move them: nothing is deleted.
admin.cat.supprimer_ok: Category deleted. The site updates in a minute or two.
admin.cat.note_creation: The folder name comes from the name (without accents or spaces). The category appears on the site as soon as it exists, even without tracks.
admin.cat.note_nom: Renaming changes the displayed name only: the folder, and so the addresses of the tracks and of the shared links, stays the same.
admin.cat.err_reserve: “{id}” is a reserved page name: choose another name.
admin.cat.err_doublon: A category with the folder “{id}” already exists.
admin.cat.err_contraste: This color has a contrast of {ratio}:1 with the site background: at least 3:1 is required.
admin.cat.err_destination: Choose another category to receive the content.
admin.cat.err_conflit: These files already exist in the destination: {chemins}.
admin.cat.err_aucune_autre: There is no other category to receive the content.
